_about: Cap-adjustment audit log — every finding from the 2026-10-06 historical audit (2017–2026), with its status and the commissioner's ruling. For our own records: an entry here changes NO MFL data unless its mfl_action says so. Add new findings with the next free id; never delete an entry, close it.

status_legend.missed_recorded: Confirmed missed: a charge, credit or settlement that never posted. Recorded for our own records only; MFL left as-is (pre-2026 seasons were run manually).
status_legend.error_recorded: Confirmed or likely wrong posting (duplicate, overcharge, inconsistent rule) in a pre-2026 manual season. Recorded for our own records only; MFL left as-is.
status_legend.partially_posted: Part of the correction is on MFL; the rest is pending (see mfl_action).
status_legend.closed: Ruled on; nothing further to do (see ruling).

source: Read-only audit, 2026-10-06: MFL salaryAdjustments + transactions 2012–2026, D1 ups_drop_events, the static salary_adjustments reports. Trades A01–A06 re-verified against MFL by hand the same day.
